C1735.title: Academic Research Reveals Characteristics of Affiliate Marketing Abuse
C1735.summary: The paper "Affiliate crookies: Characterizing affiliate marketing abuse" indicates that affiliate marketing abuse, such as cookie stuffing fraud, disproportionately targets specific entities, with a small number of affiliates dominating the market. The study reveals the prevalence of fraudulent techniques like cookie stuffing.

references.title: Affiliate crookies: Characterizing affiliate marketing abuse
